basic_details.job_title: MAIDS Dental Hygienist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences (MAIDS) has announced 1 vacancy for the post of Dental Hygienist on a contract basis under the National Health Mission (NHM) - Mobile Dental Clinic Project. Candidates can apply offline by submitting the prescribed form by hand or by post to the Dept. of Mobile Dental Clinic Project, Room No.20, Phase I Building, Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences on or before 6 November 2026, starting from 16 October 2026. important_instructions: The post is for the project “Mobile Dental Clinic Project”. The incumbent will have no right for regular appointment. Age and experience will be reckoned w.r.t. 06/11/2026. Applications lacking complete information as per the proforma or failure in submission of copies of relevant documents will be liable to be rejected without any communication. The Competent Authority reserves the right to change the number of vacancies, withdraw the process in full or in part, and reject any or all applications without assigning reasons. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Complete application in the prescribed format along with the documents must reach on or before 06/11/2026 up-to 03:30 PM directly by hand or by Post to Dept. of Mobile Dental Clinic Project, Room No.20, Phase I Building, Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences, Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi:110002.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications and Category: Senior Secondary from Regular School. Dental Hygienist course from a recognised Dental institute. Should be registered in Delhi Dental council as Delhi Dental Council as Dental Hygienist. OBC Category (OBC certificate should be issued from Govt. of NCT Delhi as "OBC _(Delhi )"). The OBC candidates must be in possession of non-creamy layer certificate, along with his/her caste certificate. The validity of the non-creamy layer certificate should be for the financial year 2026-27 i.e certificate issued on or after 1.4.2026. Desirable: Experience of clinical work in related field. Age Limit: 25 years as on 6/11/2026 (Age relaxation as per rules). FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self attested Documents PHOTO ID PROOF (Pan Card, Aadhar Card, Voter ID Card etc.) Self attested Dental Hygienist course from a recognised Dental Institute. Self attested Work experience and character certificate OBC and Non Creamy Layer Certificate issued on or after 01/04/2026 Any other additional qualifications

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of the scrutiny of applications by the Competent Authority. Eligible candidates will be called for an interview. The call list for the interview/written exam will be displayed on the institutional website.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The post is for the project “Mobile Dental Clinic Project”. The incumbent will have no right for regular appointment. Age and experience will be reckoned w.r.t. 06/11/2026. Applications lacking complete information as per the proforma or failure in submission of copies of relevant documents will be liable to be rejected without any communication. The Competent Authority reserves the right to change the number of vacancies, withdraw the process in full or in part, and reject any or all applications without assigning reasons. No TA/DA or other allowances will be paid to candidates for the interview, screening test, or joining. The institute will not be responsible for any postal delay; applications reaching after the closing date shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for Dental Hygienist?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available under the Mobile Dental Clinic Project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the complete application is 06/11/2026 up-to 03:30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Senior Secondary from a regular school, completed a Dental Hygienist course from a recognised dental institute, and be registered with the Delhi Dental Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 25 years as on 06/11/2026, with age relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the consolidated contractual remuneration?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 21,917/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What category is eligible for this post?
faq.answer: The vacancy is reserved for the OBC category, specifically requiring an OBC certificate issued from the Govt. of NCT of Delhi as "OBC _(Delhi )" along with a non-creamy layer certificate valid for the financial year 2026-27 (issued on or after 01/04/2026).

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format along with documents directly by hand or by post to Room No. 20, Phase I Building, MAIDS, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is strictly on a contract basis under the National Health Mission (NHM) for the Mobile Dental Clinic Project, and incumbents have no right to regular appointment.
